heading: Our Mission
description: InfoHR is a premier HR technology and Voice AI platform engineered to bridge the gap between academic credentials and field competency in Vietnam's vital technical and economic industries.

aboutUsPage.tabTitle: About Us — Domain Recruitment & Real-Time Voice AI Platform | InfoHR
aboutUsPage.heroTitle: Redefining Technical Recruitment with Verified Data & Transparent Voice AI
aboutUsPage.heroLead: InfoHR was engineered to eliminate the disconnect between resume claims and real-world competency. We establish specialized recruitment standards across 4 vital engineering sectors — combining a verified credentials talent exchange with 24/7 AILA Voice AI screening.

problemSection.title: Why the Market Needs InfoHR
problemSection.description: Conventional recruitment squanders millions of productive hours due to superficial resume screening and the crisis of embellished CVs.

traditionalPains.title: Inflated CVs & Embellished Skills
traditionalPains.desc: Over 75% of candidate profiles rely on generic online templates, obscuring true competency gaps until costly post-hire disillusionment.

traditionalPains.title: Manual Pre-Screening Call Fatigue
traditionalPains.desc: HR specialists spend 20 to 30 hours per week repeating routine preliminary questions, dragging hiring cycles out to 3-4 weeks per opening.

traditionalPains.title: Subjective Biases & Data-Deficient Decisions
traditionalPains.desc: Early screening rounds are easily influenced by appearance, age, or regional bias rather than objective domain mastery and verified track record.

solutionPoints.title: Standardized Technical Profiles & Verified Licenses
solutionPoints.desc: Clean separation between self-reported resumes and verified professional licenses (Grade I/II/III), technical degrees, and completed project milestones.

solutionPoints.title: Autonomous 24/7 AILA Voice AI Pre-Screening
solutionPoints.desc: Candidates interview at their own convenience via natural spoken dialogue. The system produces real-time transcripts and STAR competency assessments.

solutionPoints.title: 80% Faster Time-to-Hire
solutionPoints.desc: Hiring panels evaluate comprehensive skill matrices and recorded interview transcripts, closing high-caliber talent in as little as 48 hours.

industriesSection.title: Specialized Across 4 Vital Engineering Verticals
industriesSection.description: Instead of building a generic job board, InfoHR deliberately focuses on 4 sectors demanding strict statutory licensing and rigorous technical accountability.

items.name: Construction & Project Management
items.roles: Chief Site Engineers, Structural Supervisors, QS/QC Engineers, HSE Officers
items.challenge: Strictly requires Ministry of Construction Practicing Certificates (Grade I/II/III) and rugged field leadership that generic boards cannot filter.
items.solution: Digital certification verification, specialized Voice AI situational questions covering on-site crisis management, safety protocols, and shop drawing execution.

items.name: Real Estate & Project Development
items.roles: Real Estate Legal Counsel, Project M&A, Building Operations, Asset Valuators
items.challenge: Demands mastery over Land Law, Real Estate Business Law, cash flow modeling, and executive-level negotiations that cannot be treated like mass retail.
items.solution: Evaluates regulatory acumen, feasibility assessment logic, and high-stakes negotiation demeanor through dynamic Voice AI interactive scenarios.

items.name: Architecture & Interior Design
items.roles: Principal Architects, Interior Designers, 3D Visualizers, Structural Designers
items.challenge: Skill is validated through real-world built portfolios, spatial intelligence, and software fluency (Revit, BIM, 3ds Max, AutoCAD, SketchUp).
items.solution: High-fidelity digital portfolio vault, design philosophy cross-referencing, and verification of detailed construction drawing experience.

items.name: MEP Engineering & Building Systems
items.roles: Mechanical/Electrical/Plumbing Designers, HVAC Engineers, Fire Protection Engineers, BMS Automation
items.challenge: Stringent safety regulations (QCVN 06 Fire Safety), electrical load calculations, and building automation requiring absolute zero-tolerance for error.
items.solution: Specialized interview scripts aligned with MEP engineering codes, electrical load modeling, and statutory inspection acceptance track records.

ecosystemSection.title: The 4 Subsystems of the InfoHR Platform
ecosystemSection.description: Each component serves a dedicated milestone within the human capital lifecycle, connected in real-time.

items.name: Technical Job Seeker Portal
items.desc: Built for specialized professionals. Create competency-structured CVs, discover radius-based verified openings, and practice with Voice AI.

items.name: Recruiter Command Center
items.desc: Built for talent acquisition teams. Publish SEO-optimized engineering JDs, access verified candidate pools, and manage Kanban recruitment pipelines.

items.name: AILA Voice AI Interview Suite
items.desc: 24/7 WebRTC voice interview engine. Automates initial screening, eliminates scheduling friction, and exports objective STAR skill gap matrices.

items.name: Workforce HRM Management
items.desc: End-to-end employee lifecycle: seamless onboarding transition, digital employment contracts, employee master records, attendance, and org charts.

technologySection.title: Battle-Tested Architecture & Responsible AI
technologySection.description: We treat AI not as an opaque black box, but as an objective, transparent pre-screening assistant safeguarding both candidate dignity and employer trust.

cards.title: Low-Latency WebRTC SFU (LiveKit)
cards.desc: Sub-300ms audio streaming with active noise suppression, facilitating natural spoken human-agent dialogue without perceptible latency.

cards.title: Ethical AI: Humans Hold Final Authority
cards.desc: AILA AI never unilaterally rejects or approves candidates. It acts as an impartial recording secretary, delivering structured evidence to human hiring committees.

cards.title: Enterprise Security & Zero Data Reselling
cards.desc: All candidate resumes, audio streams, and interview transcripts are encrypted with AES-256 on isolated MinIO S3 storage behind an OWASP WAF edge shield.

corporateSection.companyName: InfoHR Technology — Architecting Digital Enterprise Solutions
corporateSection.companyDesc: InfoHR is a strategic HRTech platform. Backed by solid engineering infrastructure and extensive experience serving top enterprises in Vietnam, InfoHR is committed to sustainable value and market transparency.

ctaSection.title: Ready to Experience the New Standard in Technical Hiring?
ctaSection.desc: Whether you are an engineer seeking your next career leap or an enterprise hunting for technical leaders, InfoHR is your trusted partner.
